title: "زینبؑ تیرے درداں توں یہ حال ہو گیا اے"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Noha"
poet: "Sahib"

aliases: []

Zainab tayray dardan toon yeh haal ho gaya aye
Sajjad Dai Kafan Da,  Rang Laal Ho Gaya Aye

1
Akhai Sajjad Mola pavain akhari ni savaan
Bhuliyan ajai vi mainu nahin Shaam di a ravan
Zainab tera kyun perda,  Pamaal Ho Gaya Aye

2
Darday yateem pa ker chumain pioo da hai janaza
Hairaan kul khudai wagda ai khoon taza
Abid zulam anokha,  taray naal ho gaya hai

3
Sadmain nai lahu rovandai bazar jarn valai
Tukrai/Dukhrai?? Jigar nu kha gayai derbar jarn valai
Akhiyon chon dil da zahir,  aio ho haal ho gaiya aye

4
Kassiyan hoyan nai rassiyan massom gardana tai
Kuch reham khao logo majboor qaidiyan tai
Piyasa baihosh sada,  her baal ho gaiya aye

5
Untha di rassiyan nu chad kai jai benda qaidi
Barsat koraiyan di baitab sehnda qaidi
Kerbal chon shaam tayeen,  Bai Haal ho gaiya aye

6
Kita salaam abid, Ghabraa gaia sharabi
Darbar nu hila gai, guftar buturabi
Sahib Pata Oh Welay Lajpal Ho Gaya Aye

7
Pathran nai keeta zakhmi Zainab dai paak sar nu
Bijihiyan hoyan nai zulfaan Zainab dikhavai her nu
Aabid tarap tarap kai,  Bai Haal Ho gaiya aye

item.text:
Reconstructed the two-line opening and all seven stanzas in Shahmukhi Punjabi. The verses use Punjabi grammar and vocabulary, so I updated the language metadata and removed `noUrdu`. I preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics` and checked that the two editions match in stanza and verse counts.

I read `Tukrai/Dukhrai??` as `دکھڑے` in stanza 3 and kept both candidate readings in the Roman transcription.
